definitions.explanation: Very, quite. Today it appears almost only before words of ease, as in いとも{簡単|かんたん}に, stressing how easily something was done.

examples.japanese: いとも⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解|と}いた→解く：02301_toku⟧。
examples.english: He solved it with the greatest of ease.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いとも⟦たやすく→たやすい：10401_tayasui⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げた→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧。
examples.english: He lifted the heavy box as if it were nothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧かけて⟦{築|きず}いた→築く：02046_kizuku⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦たった→たった：00403_tatta⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧うそ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いとも⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{崩|くず}れて→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Trust built up over years collapsed all too easily with a single lie.

notes:
From the classical adverb いと (very) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧. It often carries surprise that something hard was done, or something valuable lost, so easily.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いとも⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: with the greatest ease
- いとも⟦たやすく→たやすい：10401_tayasui⟧: effortlessly
- いとも⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧: to collapse all too easily

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very; the everyday word, with no special tie to ease
- ⟦{楽々|らくらく}→楽々：21434_rakuraku⟧: easily, comfortably
